MobilityService.description: Service that enables movement of Persons between Locations.

type.description: Nature of the mobility service. For example, public transport, parking, etc. Combinations are possible, for example collective transport & public transport (e.g. NMBS), individual transport & private transport (taxis)... Lijst van TypeOfService items.

spatialCoverage.description: Area or Place within which the Mobility Service is offered. For example, Brussels Region, Antwerp... Lijst van Location items.

availability.description: Availability of the Mobility Service. For example, timetable or opening hours. Lijst van Availability items.

accessibility.description: Accessibility of the Mobility Service. For example, whether the Mobility Service is accessible to people with disabilities. Lijst van Accessibility items.

meansOfTransport.description: Means of transport with or for which the Mobility Service is usually organised. For example, metro, tram, bus for STIB. For example, car, bicycle for Coovi car park. Lijst van MeansOfTransport items.

drive.description: Drive of the means of transport with or for which the Mobility Service is usually organised. Lijst van Aandrijftype items.

pricingPlan.description: Price plan of the Mobility Service. Lijst van PricingPlan items.

carriedOutBy.description: Operator of the Mobility Service. May differ from the Provider. Lijst van Performer items.

resource.description: Resource available to the Mobility Service. We limit ourselves here to Resources that a Passenger can reserve for the performance of his Trip, for example the seat on a train but not the train with which the Mobility Service is realized. Lijst van Resource items.

includes.description: More specific Mobility Services of which the Mobility Service is composed. For example, public transport in Brussels offered by STIB consists of a number of metro lines, for example line 5 Erasmus-Herman-Debroux.Or a MAAS provider integrates several services, for example public transport and shared transport. Lijst van MobilityService items.

availableOn.description: Transport object on which the Mobility Service is offered. For example, P+R is offered at the station car park, shared bike+train offered at combi point. Lijst van TransportObject items.

offeredInside.description: Formal Framework within which the Mobility Service is offered. For example, Decree in which the criteria for licensing a Mobility Service are listed. Lijst van FormalFrame items.

license.description: License under which the Mobility Service is offered. Lijst van License items.

Location.placeName.description: Name of the place or area.

Location.title: Location
Location.description: Indication of a geographical position,by means of coordinates,a toponym,an address label,a reference to a place/region or reference to an address.

Switch.switchingTime.title: Switch.switchingTime
Switch.switchingTime.description: Time in which the switch happens.

Switch.title: Switch
Switch.description: Logical connection between two Route Nodes.

FormalFrame.title: FormalFrame
FormalFrame.description: Set of formal documents that describe rules, rights, obligations towards citizens, governments, companies, etc.

applicationArea.description: The geographical scope of the formal framework. In other words, whether it is European, national, local, for example. Lijst van Location items.

isRelatedTo.description: Other formal framework related to the formal framework. Lijst van FormalFrame items.

Ticket.quantity.title: Ticket.quantity
Ticket.quantity.description: Number of journeys that can be made with the Ticket.

Ticket.duration.title: Ticket.duration
Ticket.duration.description: Total time that can be used with the Ticket of a Mobility Service. For example, 1 hour in the case of a metro ticket or 1 day for a day ticket or a credit of 120 minutes shared scooter.

Ticket.title: Ticket
Ticket.description: Proof of certain right to transport or services associated with it.

itinerary.description: Sequence of Locations for which the Ticket is valid. Typically the two consecutive Locations between which one can travel with the Ticket, for example a train season ticket between Brussels and Ghent (where the type of Ticket is usually "return ticket", i.e. a Trip from Ghent to Brussels is also possible). But it can also simply be the Area or Place to which the Ticket applies, for example Antwerp. Lijst van Location items.

Provider.preferredName.title: Provider.preferredName
Provider.preferredName.description: Name by which the Organization is preferably designated.

contactInfo.description: Information such as email, telephone... that allows the Organisation to be contacted. Lijst van ContactInfo items.

Booking.date.title: Booking.date
Booking.date.description: Time at which the Booking was made. This time is typical of the departure time of the trip.

Booking.title: Booking
Booking.description: Recording a Trip by purchasing a Transport Ticket and/or reserving a Resource.

ticket.description: Ticket for the booked Trip. Lijst van Ticket items.

resource.description: Resource that is reserved. Lijst van Resource items.

PricingPlan.title: PricingPlan
PricingPlan.description: Price of the Trips that can be carried out with the Mobility Service.

RoutePlanner.title: RoutePlanner
RoutePlanner.description: Software that can be used to calculate the Route of a Trip.

integratesInfoOver.description: About Transport Networks that a Route Planner uses to calculate Routes. This integration typically involves merging descriptions of Transport Networks into a graph over which shortest, fastest etc paths can be calculated. Lijst van TransportNetwork items.

PublicOrganization.preferredName.title: PublicOrganization.preferredName
PublicOrganization.preferredName.description: Name by which the Organization is preferably designated.

PublicOrganization.title: PublicOrganization
PublicOrganization.description: An Organisation that belongs to the public sector according to a legal framework, regardless of the level of government at which that framework is in force.

scope.description: Administrative area covering the Public Organisation. Lijst van Location items.

Reservation.title: Reservation
Reservation.description: Characteristics of the Resource Reservation with a Booking.

itinerary.description: Itinerary for which something is reserved. For example, seat from Brussels to Paris. Lijst van Location items.

RouteNode.title: RouteNode
RouteNode.description: Significant position in the Route that always coincides with the beginning or end of a Route Segment.

TransportConnection.title: TransportConnection
TransportConnection.description: Logical connection between two or more Transport objects in different Transport networks.

connects.description: Transport objects that are connected by the Transport connection. Lijst van TransportObject items.

TransportNetwork.title: TransportNetwork
TransportNetwork.description: Collection of Network Elements representing the same mode of transport.

consistsOf.description: Transport objects that make up the Transport Network. Lijst van TransportObject items.

Traveller.title: Traveller
Traveller.description: Person who undertakes or wants to undertake a Trip.

characteristic.description: Characteristic of the Traveler. Lijst van Characteristic items.

undertakes.description: Journey that a Traveller undertakes or intends to undertake. Lijst van Journey items.

ticket.description: Passenger's ticket. Can be separate from a Trip, i.e. one can have a Ticket where the Journey is not yet fixed or has not yet been made, for example a season ticket or a day ticket. Lijst van Ticket items.

preference.description: Traveller's Preferences. Lijst van Preference items.

isFellowTravelerFrom.description: Traveller accompanying the Traveller during the Journey. For example, the children of a family that travels together. This is important, for example, when determining the price of a Ticket when young children travel for free. Lijst van Traveller items.

License.title: License
License.description: Formal permission to offer a Mobility Service.

applicationArea.description: Territory or Place in which the License applies. Lijst van Location items.

obtainedWithin.description: Formal Framework within which the License was obtained. For example, the set of criteria that a Mobility Service must meet. Lijst van FormalFrame items.

TransportArea.title: TransportArea
TransportArea.description: Two-dimensional Transport Object in a Transport Network.

TransportKnot.title: TransportKnot
TransportKnot.description: Significant position in the Transport Network that always coincides with the beginning or end of a Transport Link.

Availability.openingHoursString.title: Availability.openingHoursString
Availability.openingHoursString.description: Hours when something is available. Syntax according to schema.org for opening hours. For example, if contact can be made between 8 a.m. and 8 p.m. Monday to Saturday and between 8 a.m. and 6 p.m. on Sunday, this will be coded as Mon-Sat 08:00-20:00, Sun 08:00-18:00.

Availability.title: Availability
Availability.description: Extent to which something is available for use.

Geometry.wKT.title: Geometry.wKT
Geometry.wKT.description: Geometry expressed in CHP format. Use http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#wktLiteral as a data type.

Geometry.gml.title: Geometry.gml
Geometry.gml.description: Geometry expressed in gml format. Use http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#gmlLiteral as a data type.

Geometry.title: Geometry
Geometry.description: Shape and position characteristics of an object.

QuantitativeValue.unity.title: QuantitativeValue.unity
QuantitativeValue.unity.description: The unit in which the value is expressed. To be used when no standard unit is known.

QuantitativeValue.title: QuantitativeValue
QuantitativeValue.description: Indication of the quantity of a certain characteristic of an object.

Timetable.title: Timetable
Timetable.description: Planning in time and space of a service.

GerichteLink.title: GerichteLink
GerichteLink.description: Link in either its positive or negative direction.

LineString.wKT.title: LineString.wKT
LineString.wKT.description: Geometry expressed in CHP format. Use http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#wktLiteral as a data type.

LineString.gml.title: LineString.gml
LineString.gml.description: Geometry expressed in gml format. Use http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#gmlLiteral as a data type.

LineString.title: LineString
LineString.description: Curve with linear interpolation between the points. Each successive pair of points forms a line segment. The line string has at least two points.

StandardUnit.title: StandardUnit
StandardUnit.description: Unity established by a standardizing organization.

Value.title: Value
Value.description: The concrete, quantitative or qualitative interpretation of a quantity or category.

Point.wKT.title: Point.wKT
Point.wKT.description: Geometry expressed in CHP format. Use http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#wktLiteral as a data type.

Point.gml.title: Point.gml
Point.gml.description: Geometry expressed in gml format. Use http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#gmlLiteral as a data type.

Point.title: Point
Point.description: A 0-dimensional geometric object representing a particular location in a coordinate space. Has an x-coordinate and a y-coordinate. Can also have a z-coordinate (height) and an m-coordinate (distance along a curve).

Accessibility.title: Accessibility
Accessibility.description: Extent to which something can be achieved.

Pseudonym.title: Pseudonym
Pseudonym.description: Name of a Person who is different from his real name.

Identifier.title: Identifier
Identifier.description: Information used to uniquely identify an object.

Polygon.wKT.title: Polygon.wKT
Polygon.wKT.description: Geometry expressed in CHP format. Use http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#wktLiteral as a data type.

Polygon.gml.title: Polygon.gml
Polygon.gml.description: Geometry expressed in gml format. Use http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#gmlLiteral as a data type.

Polygon.title: Polygon
Polygon.description: Area consisting of 1 outer boundary and 0 or more internal boundaries. Each inner border forms a hole in the polygon.

OpeningHoursSpecification.title: OpeningHoursSpecification
OpeningHoursSpecification.description: Information about the opening hours of a place or service.

ContactInfo.title: ContactInfo
ContactInfo.description: Information such as email, telephone, address that allows to contact someone or something.
